name: Gohma
strategy: Grapple Valoo's tail with the Grappling Hook to swing across and drop a chunk of ceiling on her. Repeat until her shell breaks, then grapple her exposed eye and finish with your sword.

name: Kalle Demos
strategy: Cut the vines hanging from the ceiling with the Boomerang so it drops and exposes its head; strike it until it closes back up and repeat. Pouring Forest Water on its weak point kills it instantly.

name: Gohdan
strategy: Shoot the hands with arrows to stun them, then shoot the head's red eyes so it lowers and opens its mouth — toss a bomb inside.

name: Phantom Ganon
strategy: Dead Man's Volley: deflect his energy orb with your sword until it bounces back into him. He retreats after several hits.

name: Helmaroc King
strategy: Dodge until he jams his beak into the ground, then smash it with the Skull Hammer. Five hits strip off all his armor.

name: Jalhalla
strategy: Reflect light at it with the Mirror Shield to stun it, grab it, and throw it into a spiked pillar to scatter the Poes that make it up.
drop: Piece of the Triforce of Courage

name: Molgera
strategy: Keep your distance and Hookshot its blue tongue the moment it appears, then attack with your sword. Repeat for each segment.
drop: Piece of the Triforce of Courage

name: Puppet Ganon
strategy: Spider phase: shoot its eye with arrows or reflect light at it with the Mirror Shield to knock it down, then finish with your sword. Curtain phase: reflect the marionette hands' light beams into the central eye.

name: Ganondorf
strategy: Phase 1: stay defensive until Zelda lands a Light Arrow on him, then strike with your sword. Phase 2: deflect Zelda's Light Arrows with your shield into Ganondorf for the final duel.
